answer: Stop Sybil farms with seasonal work permits: an identity gains power only by completing useful tasks across several separated seasons, each checked by rotating random auditors. Like timber, reputation must season before it bears weight; a new identity starts with a tiny quota that grows only after audits in different periods. A jade seal marks a continuous audit trail, and a gap resets the quota to zero. A farmer must shepherd each fake identity through real audits over months, while a plume of honest newcomers can each earn a permit with a few genuine contributions.
